summary.tldr: Renames the federal riding of Châteauguay Lacolle to Châteauguay Les Jardins de Napierville.
what_it_does: Changes the name in the Quebec part of the 2013 federal representation order from Châteauguay Lacolle to Châteauguay Les Jardins de Napierville.
Sets the change to take effect six months after royal assent, unless the Chief Electoral Officer gives notice in the Canada Gazette that it is ready sooner.
summary.background: The bill amends the 2013 representation order made under the Electoral Boundaries Readjustment Act.
